items.title: AML Policy
items.description: The policy must be signed by the Compliance officer and managing director of the applicant

items.title: AML Policy
items.description: The policy must describe if the operator relies on third parties for CDD and how that is arranged.

items.title: AML Policy
items.description: The policy must define the rules and risk controls around virtual assets and crypto usage.

items.title: Know your customer
items.description: The policy must explain the procedure that needs to be followed when a PEP is identified, including the procedure for obtaining senior management approval, establishing the player's source of wealth and, where applicable, their source of funds and conducting enhanced on-going monitoring of the customer’s activity.

items.title: Know your customer
items.description: The policy must set out the procedure to be followed and the sources which will be used to gather and obtain information on the Purpose and Intended Nature of the Business Relationship and build a business and risk profile for the different player risk categories.

items.title: Responsible Gaming
items.description: The RG policy must outline the procedure for post-registration account closure upon the operator becoming aware that the player is a minor.

items.title: Responsible Gaming
items.description: The RG policy must state the operator's record-keeping policy.

items.title: Responsible Gaming
items.description: The RG policy must include a structured process on flagging potential vulnerable gamblers.

items.title: Responsible Gaming
items.description: "The RG policy must contain a structured process for responding to indicators of problem gambling. The key monitoring factors include: - Deposit and wagering frequency - Repeated failed transactions due to insufficient funds - Reversing withdrawals - A pattern of inexplicable extended play sessions - Unreasonable increased communication with customer support, including requests for bonuses - Frequent changes to RG tools - Players maxing out a credit card - Attempts to open multiple accounts to bypass deposit or loss limits"

items.title: Responsible Gaming
items.description: The RG policy must establish player profiles to assess risk levels

items.title: Responsible Gaming
items.description: The RG policy must adopt RBA to determine level of monitoring and intervention

items.title: Responsible Gaming
items.description: The RG policy must state that the operators records all RG interactions in the PAM system.

items.title: Responsible Gaming
items.description: The RG policy must define the procedure to be followed for players identified as vulnerable persons

items.title: Responsible Gaming
items.description: Operator must offer players the option to self-exclude themselves for a duration of at least 1 year

items.title: Responsible Gaming
items.description: Players must be able to initiate and complete the self-exclusion process fully online

items.title: Responsible Gaming
items.description: "The RG policy must state that the operator must not engage in irresponsible advertising, including: - No targeting of Vulnerable Groups - No portrayal of Gambling as an Investment - No misrepresentation of Skill vs Chance - No Emotional Manipulation - Marketing materials must not feature minors or depict them engaging with gambling content - No explicit content - No encouragement of Unrelated Harmful Behaviours - Bonuses and promotions must be communicated transparently - Operators must not use bonuses to encourage excessive gambling - Operator is responsible for materials provided to affiliates, representatives, sponsorships, ambassadors, social media influencers - Operator must make any contracted third-party aware of their RG policy - All advertising must include a clearly visible RG message or slogan"

items.title: Players Complaints
items.description: The policy must state that players may lodge a complaint free of charge at any time up to six months of the settlement of the bet or the incident about which they are making a complaint.

items.title: Player Complaints
items.description: The complaints procedure must state that complaints can only be made by the registered player.

items.title: Player Complaint
items.description: Complaints related to responsible gaming should be prioritized due to potential impacts on player well-being. Complaints should be categorized as related to responsible gaming in any case when it regards targeting of Vulnerable Players, the availability and/or timely implementation of self-exclusion and/or cooling-off and the mandated consequences therein as outlined in the Responsible Gaming policy.

items.title: Player Complaints
items.description: The operator will assess and respond to complaints within four weeks. If necessary, due to complexity or lack of information, this period may be extended once by an additional four weeks, with prior written notice to the player.
